# EN

Markdown sources of the posts published on [wxhboy.cn](https://wxhboy.cn).

| File | URL |
| --- | --- |
| `rewrite-blog-theme.md` | `https://wxhboy.cn/rewrite-blog-theme/` |

- The file name is the URL, so renaming a file breaks its link.
- The title comes from the front-matter `title`, not the file name.
- Pushing to this branch rebuilds the site — see `.github/workflows/deploy-blog.yml`.

# 中文

[wxhboy.cn](https://wxhboy.cn) 文章的 Markdown 源文件。

| 文件 | 地址 |
| --- | --- |
| `rewrite-blog-theme.md` | `https://wxhboy.cn/rewrite-blog-theme/` |

- 文件名就是 URL，改名等于换链接。
- 标题取自 front-matter 的 `title`，不看文件名。
- 推送到本分支会触发整站重新构建，见 `.github/workflows/deploy-blog.yml`。
